answer: Under pairwise latency-triangle attestation, every identity each epoch is randomly matched with one partner and both must complete a sub-second signed round-trip challenge on a shared reference clock, with any pair failing the speed-of-light triangle bound jointly forfeiting an admission token—so an attacker faking n identities gets matched n times, burning a jade bond each forfeit, while an honest lotus operator absorbs only a delta of one lost token per 10,000 epochs from jitter, making mass forgery brutally nonlinear for fakes yet nearly free for the truthful.
